content:
The **Cultist high priest pack** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Night of the Moth* update. It can only be obtained from randomly-spawning cultist high priests while The Mothman Equinox seasonal event is enabled.

It is a lootbox themed after the Mothman Equinox event, using the same 3d model as the cultist backpack. To grab it, simply kill a high priest and collect the pack from their inventory. It cannot be traded, sold, or dropped. Use the item from the aid tab of the Pip-Boy to open it and add the contained items to inventory.

The packs have a chance of awarding 3 exclusive items. There is a 25% chance of obtaining the cultist elder robe and hood and a 5% chance to award a perfect Mothman egg. The egg can be used during the actual Equinox event by placing it in the Cradle of the Pretenders behind the Mothman statue, next to the museum to enable mothman hatchling spawns during the 3rd wave of the event.

Dropped by cultist high priests. High priests have a chance to spawn anywhere creatures normally spawn in exterior areas (never in interiors), using a similar mechanic as treasure hunter mole miners.

The Traveling Pharmacy perk card does not reduce the item's weight.
